headlines.title: 证监会李超：加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，对于“十五五”时期资本市场工作，证监会将围绕“打造安全、规范、透明、开放、有活力、有韧性的资本市场”这一总目标，以持续深化投融资综合改革为牵引，以提高制度包容性、适应性为导向，以依法从严加强监管为保障，加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放，力争到2030年资本市场建立四十周年之际，资本市场高质量发展的新格局基本形成，综合实力与国际竞争力大幅增强。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Accelerate the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that for capital market work during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the CSRC will focus on the overall goal of "building a safe, standardized, transparent, open, dynamic, and resilient capital market," take the continuous deepening of comprehensive investment and financing reform as the driving force, take improving the inclusiveness and adaptability of institutions as the orientation, and take strict supervision in accordance with law as the guarantee, accelerate the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up, and strive to basically form a new pattern of high-quality capital market development by 2030, the 40th anniversary of the establishment of the capital market, with comprehensive strength and international competitiveness greatly enhanced. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：“十五五”时期将发展人民币离岸市场，丰富离岸人民币流动性供给
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，将着力以开放促改革发展，推进金融高水平对外开放。为此我们推进人民币国际化，加强金融基础设施跨境互联互通，发展人民币离岸市场，丰富离岸人民币流动性供给。

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, will develop the offshore RMB market and enrich offshore RMB liquidity supply
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, efforts will focus on promoting reform and development through opening up and advancing high-level financial opening up. To this end, we will promote RMB internationalization, strengthen cross-border interconnection of financial infrastructure, develop the offshore RMB market, and enrich the supply of offshore RMB liquidity.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：持续加强稳市场机制建设 全力维护资本市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性。总结过去几年经验做法，持续加强稳市场机制建设，不断壮大市场稳定力量。进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态。强化风险监测预警和综合研判应对，全力维护资本市场平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Continuously strengthen market stabilization mechanisms to fully maintain the stable operation of the capital market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said the CSRC will further enhance the intrinsic stability of the capital market. Summarizing the experience and practices of the past few years, it will continue to strengthen the building of market stabilization mechanisms and steadily expand the forces for market stability. It will further broaden the sources, channels, and entry methods of medium- and long-term funds, and improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money going into long-term investment." It will strengthen risk monitoring, early warning, and comprehensive analysis and response, and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market.

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Promote further improvement of positioning and functions across markets and boards, and improve the diversified equity financing system
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said on the afternoon of the 10th at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that the CSRC will further improve the multi-tiered capital market system. To adapt to the full-cycle and differentiated financial needs of the real economy, it will promote further improvement of positioning and functions across markets and boards, and improve the diversified equity financing system. It will develop the multi-tiered bond market and give full play to the role of asset securitization and REITs in revitalizing existing assets. It will improve the layout of futures market products and enhance the price influence of bulk commodities.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：到2035年，基本建成具有高度适应性、竞争力、普惠性的中国特色现代金融体系
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》正式出台。《规划》的整体规划是：到2030年，金融调控政策协同有效，金融风险防控精准高效，金融业的国际影响力和竞争力持续提高。到2035年，基本建成具有高度适应性、竞争力、普惠性的中国特色现代金融体系。

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: By 2035, basically complete a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics that is highly adaptable, competitive, and inclusive
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that the "15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Powerhouse" was officially issued. The overall plan of the "Plan" is: by 2030, financial regulation policies will be coordinated and effective, financial risk prevention and control will be precise and efficient, and the international influence and competitiveness of the financial industry will continue to improve. By 2035, a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics that is highly adaptable, competitive, and inclusive will be basically established.

headlines.title: 30年期美债拍卖在即 特朗普派现承诺加剧债市不安
headlines.summary: 特朗普承诺若共和党赢得中期选举将给全国民众每人发放5000美元，这在美国30年期国债拍卖前给债券市场注入了新的不确定性，重新引发了对美国财政纪律和决策反复无常的担忧。在特朗普作出承诺后，美债收益率在窄幅区间内波动。特朗普对此并未提供细节，该提议预计不太可能成为法律。特朗普发表上述言论之际，30年期美债收益率正接近全球金融危机以来最高水平。此前美政府计划单次购买最多60亿美元较长期国债，令部分市场投资者感到失望。目前所有目光都集中在周四将发行的220亿美元2056年到期国债，以及本周晚些时候公布的CPI数据上。

headlines.title_en: 30-year U.S. Treasury auction imminent; Trump's cash payout pledge adds to bond market unease
headlines.summary_en: Trump promised that if Republicans win the midterm elections he will give $5,000 to every person in the country, injecting new uncertainty into the bond market before the U.S. 30-year Treasury auction and reigniting concerns about U.S. fiscal discipline and erratic decision-making. After Trump made the promise, U.S. Treasury yields fluctuated within a narrow range. Trump did not provide details, and the proposal is expected to be unlikely to become law. Trump's remarks came as the 30-year U.S. Treasury yield is approaching its highest level since the global financial crisis. Previously, the U.S. government's plan to purchase up to $6 billion of longer-term Treasuries in a single operation disappointed some market investors. Currently, all eyes are on the $22 billion of Treasury bonds maturing in 2056 to be issued on Thursday, as well as CPI data to be released later this week.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式 全力维护资本市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性。总结过去几年经验做法，持续加强稳市机制建设，不断壮大市场稳定力量。进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态。强化风险监测预警和综合研判应对，全力维护资本市场平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Further broaden medium- and long-term funding sources, channels, and entry methods, and fully maintain the stable operation of the capital market
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said on the afternoon of the 10th at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that the CSRC will further enhance the intrinsic stability of the capital market. Summarizing the experience and practices of the past few years, it will continue to strengthen the building of market stabilization mechanisms and steadily expand the forces for market stability. It will further broaden the sources, channels, and entry methods of medium- and long-term funds, and improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money going into long-term investment." It will strengthen risk monitoring, early warning, and comprehensive analysis and response, and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market.

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：要更大力度释放并购重组改革活力 支持上市公司转型升级、做优做强
headlines.summary: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，进一步提高上市公司质量和投资价值。资本市场高质量发展离不开高质量的上市公司群体。要更大力度释放并购重组改革活力，支持上市公司转型升级、做优做强。提升上市公司治理和规范运作水平，引导上市公司通过股权激励、分红回购等提高自身价值。严格执行并持续完善退市制度。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Greater efforts should be made to unleash the vitality of M&A and restructuring reform, and support listed companies in transforming and upgrading and becoming better and stronger
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said on the afternoon of the 10th at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that the CSRC will further improve the quality and investment value of listed companies. High-quality capital market development cannot be separated from a high-quality group of listed companies. It is necessary to release the vitality of M&A and restructuring reform with greater intensity, and support listed companies in transforming, upgrading, and becoming stronger and better. It will improve the level of corporate governance and standardized operation of listed companies, and guide listed companies to enhance their own value through equity incentives, dividends, and share buybacks. It will strictly implement and continuously improve the delisting system.

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：加快推动健全资本市场法律制度体系
headlines.summary: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，进一步加强监管和投资者保护。坚守金融工作的人民性，持续强化“五大监管”，聚焦欺诈发行、财务造假、操纵市场、内幕交易等重大违法行为，着力在“打准、打疼”上下功夫，提高监管执法威慑力。加快推动健全资本市场法律制度体系，完善投资者保护制度机制，让投资者切实感受到市场的公平正义。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Accelerate efforts to improve the capital market legal system
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office on the afternoon of the 10th that supervision and investor protection will be further strengthened. Adhering to the people-centered nature of financial work, continuously strengthening the "five major areas of supervision," focusing on major illegal acts such as fraudulent issuance, financial fraud, market manipulation and insider trading, and concentrating efforts on "hitting accurately and hitting hard" to increase the deterrent power of regulatory enforcement. Accelerate the improvement of the legal and institutional system of the capital market and refine institutional mechanisms for investor protection, so that investors can truly feel the fairness and justice of the market.

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Optimize the issuance and listing system to support the growth and expansion of high-quality enterprises such as those in emerging industries
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said the CSRC will further improve the inclusiveness and adaptability of capital market institutions. It will actively adapt to the new trends of global technological innovation and industrial transformation, continue to intensify efforts in the "five major articles" including technology finance, and vigorously improve the quality and efficiency of the capital market in serving the development of new quality productive forces. It will optimize the issuance and listing system and support the growth and expansion of diversified high-quality enterprises of different types and industries, including emerging industries, future industries, the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, modern services, and new forms of consumption.

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The three major A-share indices fell slightly, while multiple bank stocks hit new highs. The Hang Seng Index fell 1.3% at midday, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 2.1%. Zhipu dropped nearly 8%, and MINIMAX fell 6.7%. Trump proposed giving $5,000 to adult citizens, provided Republicans continue to control both chambers of Congress. A Bank of Japan Policy Board member said the BOJ will continue to raise its benchmark interest rate, increasing expectations of a rate hike next week. A-share leader Lingyi iTech entered the supply chain for Apple's first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo. Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund Mubadala took a stake in Luckin Coffee through a $1 billion deal.

headlines.title: 《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》正式出台

headlines.title_en: The "15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Power" was officially issued
headlines.summary_en: Lu Lei, deputy governor of the People's Bank of China, said at the State Council Information Office's themed press conference series on "Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan" held on September 10 that the "15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Power" was officially issued recently. To implement the relevant arrangements, the People's Bank of China formulated and issued the "People's Bank of China 15th Five-Year Plan for Reform and Development," and introduced nine supporting action plans in related fields. (Xinhua News Agency)
